description: The company's imports from Jira, newest first (up to 100), as the Import tab lists them: each with its id, 'status' (uploading, scanQueued, scanning, scanned — a plan to read — queued, importing, done, failed, cancelled), the site and project key, how far it got ('done' of 'total'), its error, who asked and when. 'tokenHeld' says whether a Jira token is still kept — the token itself is never in any answer. The company's administrator only.
name: list_imports
title: List imports
